title: System
cronNote: Toggle a task on and set when it runs with a cron pattern — min hour day month weekday. Examples: 0 9 * * 3 = Wednesdays 9am · 0 */12 * * * = every 12 hours. A run missed while the app was off catches up once at the next start.
cronTitle: min hour day month weekday — e.g. 0 9 * * 3 = Wednesdays 9am
noJobs: No jobs yet. Background tasks (crawl, metadata match, scans, tagging, release checks) show up here.
toolsLead: Library-wide maintenance. Each runs in the background — you can leave this page and watch progress on the Jobs tab.
reorganizeDesc: Move & rename every matched series' files to your folder and file patterns (Settings → Library → File organization). Preview first — nothing changes until you reorganize.
showingFirstMoves: Showing the first {shown} of {total} moves — the rest follow the same patterns.
nothingToMove: Nothing to move — files already match your patterns.
confirmReorganizeMessage: Every matched series is moved/renamed to match your folder and file patterns. This changes files on disk and runs in the background — progress shows here and on the Jobs tab.
supportDesc: One zip to attach to a bug report: version and build, runtime, settings, plugins, libraries, jobs, recent downloads and the log. API keys, passwords and tokens are redacted; no comics, user names or e-mail addresses are included.
sentQuoteCode: Sent. Quote this code in your report:
supportNotePlaceholder: What's wrong? (optional, goes with the package)
dupesDelete: Also delete extra good copies (unticked = preview them to Logs)
nothingLogged: Nothing logged yet. Warnings and errors show up here as they happen.
